\begin{abstract}
Anchor placement is usually evaluated with the budget left free. We present a
comparison that holds the budget fixed, and we report coverage at every
placement count we measured.
\end{abstract}

\begin{IEEEkeywords}
anchor placement, fixed budget, coverage, indoor localization
\end{IEEEkeywords}

\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}

Geometric placement is reported to beat greedy placement on this benchmark.
We measured both at a fixed budget and the ordering reverses.

\section{Results}
\label{sec:results}

Geometric placement fails outright once the budget is held fixed. Coverage
falls from 0.81 to 0.54 across the four floors we measured, and the greedy
placement holds at 0.79 on the same floors. We ran each configuration five
times.
